//go:build sessionless_search_offline

package worker

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/x509"
	"errors"
	"net"
	"net/netip"

	"gitcode.com/urandon/sessionless/internal/ports"
)

// This test-only method uses the same actual session constructor, Manager run
// and close path as public RunOnce. It is explicitly shared-production-path
// evidence, not a claim that the literal public entry accepts network options.
func (r *LocalRuntime) RunOnceSearchOffline(ctx context.Context, queue ports.Queue, lookup func(context.Context, string) ([]netip.Addr, error), dial func(context.Context, string, string) (net.Conn, error), roots *x509.CertPool, shutdown chan<- func() error) (Outcome, error) {
	if nilLocalRuntimeDependency(queue) {
		return "", ErrLocalRuntime
	}
	session, err := r.newLocalSession(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if err := session.ConfigureSearchOfflineNetwork(lookup, dial, roots); err != nil {
		return "", errors.Join(err, session.Close())
	}
	if shutdown != nil {
		select {
		case shutdown <- session.StopActiveSearchOffline:
		default:
			return "", errors.Join(ErrLocalRuntime, session.Close())
		}
	}
	return r.runLocalSession(ctx, queue, session)
}
